headline: Seventeen under high thin cloud.
body: The air has warmed to seventeen. A south-south-west wind runs at thirteen kilometres an hour while pressure at one thousand twenty-nine begins to fall. Cloud covers most of the sky; the streets remain dry.

pulses.value: mostly cloudy, 17°C, SSW 13 km/h, pressure 1029 falling

pulses.value: sun near noon; high cloud, soft brightness
